name: Infernal Colleague
source: Heroes of the High Court pg. 3
body:
Drawbacks
Infernal Colleague
Source Heroes of the High Court pg. 3
Category Basic (Social)
Requirement(s) Associated with the court of the Imperial Palace in Cheliax
Your experience working with devils has given you nerves of steel. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Will saves to resist fear effects created by outsiders.
